name: Bedirhan Oktu
profile: Mathematics student at Middle East Technical University (METU), currently in the English preparatory year, admitted with a result in the top 0.84% of the quantitative track of Türkiye's national entrance examination. Outside class I build software on my own — native Apple apps in Swift and web apps in TypeScript. I am looking for an international academic environment where mathematics and software work can grow together.

projects.title: Köprü
projects.text: A native macOS launcher for running Windows games on Apple Silicon, built to learn how compatibility layers work. Wine is compiled from source on a CrossOver 26.3 base with custom patches, and Apple's D3DMetal translates DirectX 11/12 calls to Metal. The Witcher 3 (DirectX 12) runs through Steam.

projects.title: Denge
projects.text: A screen-time balance app: time spent reading or working earns phone time at a set ratio, with a daily cap, focus sessions and a progress view. Working prototype with five visual themes; all data stays on the device, with no accounts or servers.

projects.title: Karteikasten
projects.text: A Leitner-system flashcard app for Goethe A2 exam preparation that works fully offline.

projects.title: Blackjack
projects.text: Deals from a real, finite 52-card deck instead of random cards and reshuffles with the Fisher–Yates algorithm when the deck runs out; 3:2 payouts, dealer stands on soft 17, betting and round history.
